question: Can a bounded, sparse, tokenless causal trace, which only allocates conditional/ordered relations after physical outcome contradictions, represent two causal histories that the frozen FKP-17 unconditioned counters provably alias, without retaining a source oracle or copying a dense symbolic program enumeration?
hypothesis: Contradiction-triggered allocation of observed state-conditioned action effects and ordered predecessor-action traces will preserve physically consequential causal distinctions after two observed interventions, while the same-evidence unconditioned/no-temporal ablations collapse.

predecessor_evidence.classification: familiar TRAIN-only 64-world benefit, conditional & order alias NO_GO; original DEV unopened
WSP120 separately explores bounded graph-program growth from contradictions; do not duplicate its graph grammar or source
NKR03 independent native relation memory; do not replace accepted engine

inputs.name: source-safe public toy counterexamples
inputs.source: independently specified explicit public before/action/after/historical sequences; no held generator; research-only
inputs.sha256: NOT_FROZEN_INPUT_BINARY_BEFORE_IMPLEMENTATION; reconstruct mathematically under below fixed cases

inputs.name: FKP17 frozen public counterexample
inputs.source: FKP17 PR1109 code at SHA 272423baac407d97791409247df05e4e98fcb7da; context only, no source import

frozen_design.representation: sparse active context forks for action×target×prevalue observed deltas, activated on conflicting real outcomes; bounded last-action predecessor→current action→target event traces; absolutely no natural-language tokenization, learned transformer, unseen oracle labels, or private source imports
negative_cases: no public outcome before chosen action
unknown or held source seed denial
frozen_design.evaluation: two distinct witnessed conditional cases must retain distinguishable cold state and opposite empirically grounded predictions for same public state+action; temporal ordered traces must be distinguishable; compare with separately coded exact public conditional retrieval; prove zero private labels
frozen_design.compute_budget: stdlib Python 3.11 and 3.12, <5s per source-safe fixture; no GPU, paid APIs or new scheduler
frozen_design.seed_schedule: none: deterministic four frozen public two-step witnessed trajectories, NOT any original DEV
frozen_design.science: Original DEV/transfer first use absent, real generalization untested. All original FKP17 source and prereg unchanged.

metrics: cold state representation collision count of two conditional and temporal pairs (target 0 for candidate)
correct signed action3 conditioned return for A/B
source-safe exact replay with no leakage

classification_rules.supported: ENGINEERING_REPRESENTATION_PROBE_ONLY when both conditional and temporal pairs remain distinguishable and signed action effects match public evidence, negative controls alias, and cold hash replay passes under 65536 bytes. No SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification_rules.mixed: One pair distinguishable but the other aliases, even if tests pass.
classification_rules.negative: Both pairs alias or conditioned predictions unavailable after two physical observations.
classification_rules.invalid: Prereg drift; private-source access; outcome-before-action; bogus reward; capacity exceeded; incomplete tests; unqualified source SHA/CI; checkpoint integrity failure.

prohibited_after_primary_run: source, threshold, split, learner, control or capacity retuning after measured result
copy WSP120 grammar as native Yggdrasil
preregistration_note: Committed as sole first experiment commit before implementation, source-safe probes, training or any new outcome. No original held source is opened.
